nodes.instructions: Retain exact NC/IS check receipts, then captured frame paths. Refresh affected checks after GLB/camera edits. No invented full sweep for a tiny fix.

nodes.label: Lead records applicable review flags and semantic claims
nodes.instructions: Name final structural/scientific/visible scope and false-flag reasons. Generic architecture/physics flags mean additional scope not already covered by authoring/framework reports.

nodes.label: Offline voice-tutor regression results
nodes.instructions: Free offline tests first: per-test pass/fail/not-run and actual observations. No office model calls; live conversations require a separately authorized product-test scope, never an automatic gate.

nodes.label: Lead dispositions, crew repairs and spec sync
nodes.instructions: Map findings to applied/declined-with-technical-evidence; resolve concrete blockers. Out-of-scope improvements are not delivery debt. No advisory re-review loop.

nodes.label: Non-fix requested/relevant review fan-out
nodes.instructions: Only activated scopes; never a repo-wide census or implicit taste audit. The ordinary dispatched branch bypasses this roster entirely.

nodes.label: Explicit final-checks audit procedure
nodes.instructions: Only the separately requested finished chapter/lab scope; one report per named role and honest unavailable probes. Not an automatic fix-comment roster.

nodes.label: Requested spec/render-truth chapter grounding
nodes.instructions: Matched live probes and spec/render truth; lint-specs/roundtrip after spec edits. Missing access/authorization is disclosed, never a pass.

nodes.label: check:changed before the intended commit
nodes.instructions: npm run check:changed BEFORE committing while diff supplies scope. Log unrelated-owner failures distinctly; never sweep or silently repair them.

nodes.label: Visual-check on final owned live preview
nodes.instructions: Exact state/step.beat, desktop/phone interactions and actual observations/PNG inspection. GLB/camera output captured after their edits. Unavailable capture is blocked/partial, never a pass.

nodes.label: Owner commits intended work; lead pins ready SHA
nodes.instructions: Commit ONLY intended work; refresh --candidate HEAD with the same intended-tree fingerprint to retain receipts. Dirty dev delivery is refused. Use an owned clean candidate checkout; never stash/sweep another owner.

nodes.label: First mate presents milestone/try with run snapshot
nodes.instructions: inbox milestone/try --run RUN; exact item id/revision and candidate, real frames/pages and honest limitations. Submission is not acceptance.

nodes.label: Founder accepts exact run-bound item revision
nodes.instructions: Explicit founder accept of matching try/milestone revision and candidate. Stale/withdrawn/resolved replies and approve-all automation never satisfy this requirement.

nodes.label: First mate lands pinned candidate and publishes origin/dev
nodes.instructions: Gate is preflight only. Canonical main .claude/hooks/worktree-sync.mjs land <owned-checkout> <full-SHA>; normal publication to origin/dev required. publication-pending is unfinished: retry publish, never re-land. No force-push, main push or PR merge. Only AFTER publication: linked fixed markers, report actual landed mapping/publishedDev/receipt; founder marker verification is later feedback.

pathRules.message: Docs-only cannot contain code, executable instruction resources, hooks or configuration; split mixed scopes.
Workflow/dependency changes require explicit additional architecture scope.
Routes/public assets/locales need the visible-change branch or a separately scoped non-visible policy override.
